concept: A printable haft-seen shopping checklist visitors can take to the store.
whyNow: Search interest in haft-seen items climbs sharply in the weeks before Nowruz.
designBrief: One printable page listing each haft-seen item with a short line on what it symbolizes, in the site's colors, with a small logo and the page address at the foot.
metaDescription: A printable checklist of the haft-seen items with what each one symbolizes, so your Nowruz table is complete on the first try.
imageAltRules: Name the haft-seen item shown in each photo

evidenceRefs.detail: the page earns impressions for this exact search

operatorSteps: Paste the new text into the page editor and publish
